 Advertisement Iowa climbs in the latest CFP rankings
 See where the Hawkeyes are slotted with three weeks left in the season
 Advertisement Updated: 10:56 PM CST Nov 10, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Scott Reister Sports Director Iowa climbs in the latest CFP rankings
 See where the Hawkeyes are slotted with three weeks left in the season
 Updated: 10:56 PM CST Nov 10, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Scott Reister Sports Director IOWA CITY, Iowa — Iowa (7-2) climbed four spots to No. 15 in the latest College Football Playoff rankings, which were released Tuesday night. At the end of the season, the top 12 teams will get to compete in the College Football Playoffs. 
 This content is imported from x. You may be able to find the same content in another format, or you may be able to find more information, at their web site. In order to make the field, Iowa needs to win its remaining games and hope things fall their way. Saturday, Iowa hosts 3-6 Purdue (6:30 p.m. on NBC). Next Saturday, they play at 6-3 Illinois, then host 5-4 Nebraska on Black Friday (11:00 on KCCI) to close out the regular season.
